title: In the Volgograd, the incident was started after a series
text:
The law enforcement agencies have opened a criminal case under an article about thugs after a battle of mass use of knives and customs in the Volgograd. About this, TASS is related to the press services of the Russian Federation IC.
The incident occurred on September 27, besides the street eating point in Volzhsky-Volgograd. In total, more than 20 people participated in the argument.
In social media, it was reported that in the city of Volzhsky, there was a battle of mass use of knives and class. In fact, internal agencies have opened a criminal case by art.
Press services have clarified that the investigation committee of the Russian Investigation Committee in the Volgograd is a petition to transfer materials to production for further investigation.
The General Department of the Russian Ministry of Home Affairs in the Volgograd area found that law enforcement officers are looking for an involved in an argument. At the same time, the department noted, information about the victims of health organizations has not been received by the police.
Earlier, there was a report that in May 2025, a series of stabbing occurred in one of the residential areas of Hofddorp (Netherlands). The two were killed, and somewhat seriously injured, including a police officer to an emergency.
A number of ambulance brigades, as well as a helicopter of a medical mobile vehicle, where the guards were injured to the nearest clinic, working at the scene.
